rule: A level holds a fixed count of foes: 3 + (depth mod 5) + random 0-2, times 1.33 on a LARGE feeling. Foes sit in standard rooms weighted by size (1, 2, 3); no foe is in view or within 8 steps of the arrival; one in four placements adds a second foe to the same room. The foes come from a per-depth deck (hand-written list, shuffled, regenerated when empty). A respawn actor refills the count one foe at a time, always at path distance 12 or more from the hero and set to wandering; the cooldown is 50 by default and two-thirds in dark levels. Vault wanderers loop four inset corners, clockwise or counter-clockwise by coin flip, and notice the hero inside a facing cone or by 1 in (distance + stealth). Boss levels create no refill (addRespawner returns null).
keep: Arrival is clean: no foe in view or within 8 steps, so the first sprite is a decision.
A fixed count per level from a simple formula, plus a one-in-four pair rule.
A per-depth deck of families, shuffled and regenerated, as the variety engine.
Respawn from the far side only, one at a time, up to the count, server-rolled.
Boss arenas do not refill: one fight in a fixed arena.
Four-corner patrol loop with a facing cone for readable patrols.
change: Cap on-screen attackers at 3; the formula feeds a reserve queue, not a crowd.
Detection is computed on the server; the client draws the cone from server state.
Deck entries are character families from the 100-Pit pool, not donor monster classes.
Numbers, names, layouts, palette and sprites are our own.
look_test: Static flag on the existing scene, no release rows. Screen A: a room with the arrival marked, in two layouts, one with a foe inside eight steps and one with none; Dom judges whether the clean arrival reads as fair. Screen B: one four-corner patrol loop with a visible facing cone at 75 degrees and at 150 degrees; Dom judges which cone he can plan around. Optional screen C: a boss arena with no refill marker, to judge whether one fight, no respawn, is clear without text.
